v.1: By the heaven with its Houses,
v.3: by the Witness and the Witnessed:
v.4: perish the People of the Ditch!
v.7: as they were themselves witnesses to what they did to the faithful.
v.8: They were vindictive towards them only because they had faith in Allah, the All-mighty and the All-laudable,
v.9: to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is witness to all things.
v.10: Indeed those who persecute the faithful, men and women, and do not repent thereafter, there is the punishment of hell for them and the punishment of burning.
v.11: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—for them will be gardens with streams running in them. That is the supreme success.
v.12: Indeed your Lord’s striking is severe.
v.13: It is indeed He who originates and brings back,
v.14: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-affectionate,
v.15: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,
v.17: Did you receive the story of the hosts
v.19: Indeed the faithless dwell in denial,
v.20: and Allah besieges them from all around.
v.21: Indeed it is a glorious Quran,
